outcome: Public beliefs and knowledge regarding sexual health, pregnancy, and breastfeeding during the COVID-19 pandemic
finding: The study found that a significant proportion of the public holds misinformation about sexual intimacy, pregnancy, and breastfeeding during the COVID-19 pandemic, highlighting a need for accurate information dissemination.
mod_finding: About one-fifth (21.3%) of the participants reported going ahead with Cesarean section if the mother is suspected of having or is confirmed to have COVID-19 infection.
